exclusions: Investigation & Diagnostic only without active treatment

clauses.title: Room Rent Capping and Proportionate Deduction
clauses.text: Daily room rent is capped at INR 3,000 per day. Excess room rent billed will be deducted.

clauses.title: Co-Payment Provision
clauses.text: A mandatory co-payment of 20% applies to all admissible claim expenses under GIPSA guidelines.

clauses.title: Initial 30-Day Waiting Period
clauses.text: A waiting period of 30 days applies from policy inception, except for emergency accidental hospitalization.
